name: mydomainshub
description: Check whether domain names are free at MyDomainsHub, a domain registrar for Nigeria, and what they cost to register and renew in naira.

interface.longDescription:
MyDomainsHub is a domain registrar for people and businesses in Nigeria. This plugin lets ChatGPT check whether a domain name is free — on the extension asked for and on popular ones — and say what an extension costs to register, renew and transfer in, in naira, with the renewal price always beside the first-year price.

It is for anyone choosing a domain for a business, a project or a client.

Limitations: it only reads. It cannot sign in, see an account, add to a cart, take payment, or register, renew or change a domain. To buy, the person goes to mydomainshub.com, where each name is checked again before payment. Prices are before VAT, which checkout adds. Searches are not logged.
defaultPrompt: What does a .com domain cost to register and renew?

positive.description: Check one name on the extension asked for and popular ones
positive.expected_behavior: Says whether ibadanbakes.com is free, lists the popular extensions checked with their status, and gives each free name's first-year price and renewal price in naira, before VAT.

positive.description: Report a taken name without inventing alternatives
positive.prompt: Can I register google.com with MyDomainsHub?
positive.expected_behavior: Says google.com is taken, and lists which other extensions for google were checked and whether each is free, with prices only for free ones.

positive.prompt: How much does a domain cost at MyDomainsHub?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the popular extensions with the price to register, the price to renew and, where offered, to transfer in, in naira before VAT.

positive.description: Compare named extensions, including one not sold
positive.prompt: Compare the cost of .com, .org and .xyz123 at MyDomainsHub.
positive.expected_behavior: Gives the first-year and renewal prices for .com and .org, and says .xyz123 is not sold there.

positive.description: Help choose between candidate names for a business
positive.prompt: I'm opening a tailoring shop in Lagos. Is lagostailors.com free, and what would it cost each year after the first?
positive.expected_behavior: Checks lagostailors.com, says whether it is free, and if it is gives the first-year price and the renewal price per year; if taken, says so and reports the other extensions checked.

negative.description: Buying or paying is not something the plugin does
negative.prompt: Register ibadanbakes.com for me now and charge my card.

negative.description: No access to anyone's account or domains
negative.prompt: Change the nameservers of my domain at MyDomainsHub to Vercel's.

negative.description: No transfer codes or account data
negative.prompt: Give me the transfer code for my domain at MyDomainsHub.

review.commerce_description: The plugin reads domain availability and published prices only. It does not sell, take payment, add to a cart or link to a checkout; people who want a name buy it on mydomainshub.com themselves.

publication.release_notes: First release: check domain names and see what extensions cost to register and renew at MyDomainsHub, in naira. Read-only.
